NAME_MISMATCH.correction_action: Compare the identity record with the target record and request correction only after verifying the original document.
NAME_MISMATCH.escalation_path: Use the contact or correction channel printed on the target document or official portal.

action_item.title: Resolve name mismatch
action_item.why_it_matters: These records contain different names. The relevant authority/bank should confirm which record needs correction.
action_item.expected_output: Reprinted Passbook front page or official acknowledgement of name correction.
action_item.exact_statement_to_staff: "Please update my name in your records to match my primary identity document to prevent scheme rejections."

DOB_MISMATCH.issue: Date of birth values differ across records.
DOB_MISMATCH.correction_action: Verify the date of birth against the identity document and request correction of the conflicting record.
DOB_MISMATCH.escalation_path: Use the correction channel provided by the organization that issued the conflicting record.

action_item.title: Obtain Age / Date of Birth Clerical Correction Certificate
action_item.problem: Date of Birth mismatch detected across submitted documents.
action_item.why_it_matters: Date of birth discrepancies frequently cause clerical rejections during application processing.
instructions: Visit the issuing municipal / panchayat authority with primary family records.
Request a certified clerical correction memo reconciling the birth year.
Keep both documents along with the rectification memo before submitting the scheme application.
what_to_carry: Affidavit on stamp paper or Panchayat Secretary recommendation letter
action_item.expected_output: Official endorsement memo reconciling birth year.
action_item.exact_statement_to_staff: "My Aadhaar shows my birth year as X, but my family record shows Y. I need an official clerical correction or affidavit to reconcile this mismatch before I can file my application without rejection."
action_item.turnaround_time: Same day if affidavit, up to 15 days if municipal correction.

ADDRESS_MISMATCH.correction_action: Confirm the current address and update the record that contains the incorrect value.
ADDRESS_MISMATCH.escalation_path: Follow the correction or helpdesk channel for the target record.

action_item.title: Resolve Address Variation
action_item.why_it_matters: Usually not blocking unless outside the eligible district.
instructions: Verify your pin code and district match your Aadhaar.
If you have a separate residence certificate, use that for address verification.

MISSING_DOCUMENT.correction_action: Upload a readable copy of the required document and review extracted values.
MISSING_DOCUMENT.escalation_path: Use the official application portal or its listed helpdesk if upload is unavailable.

action_item.title: Upload Missing Document
action_item.why_it_matters: Application will be immediately rejected without this document.
instructions: Upload it to the application portal.

EXPIRED_DOCUMENT.correction_action: Obtain a current document from its issuing authority before submitting.
EXPIRED_DOCUMENT.escalation_path: Contact the issuing authority using its official published channel.

action_item.title: Renew Expired Document
action_item.problem: One or more documents have expired.
instructions: Apply for renewal of the expired document.
Wait for the new document to be issued.
